exposure: family perception of breast feeding initiation time
perception on availability of health facility
cohort: Children aged 6 to 23 months in Gedeo Zone, South Ethiopia.
finding: Marital status, maternal education level, household feeding decision maker, household food insecurity, household feeding preference, family perception of breastfeeding initiation time, knowledge on complementary feeding, and perception of health facility availability were determinants of complementary feeding initiation practices.
